question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"intelligent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Intelligent"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It is a grammatically correct adjective that fits the context. • **"Intelligent"** means having or showing the ability to understand, learn and think; clever. (समझने, सीखने और सोचने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न, बुद्धिमान; चतुर) • **Example**:* All their children are very **intelligent**__.* • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct paragraph: Literacy is a very important quality of a population. __Only__ an informed and educated citizen can make __**intelligent**__ choices and undertake research and development ______ (3) ______. Low levels of literacy are a ______ (4) ______ obstacle for economic improvement. In India, ______ (5) ______ has been a steady improvement in the literacy levels.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"best (**सर्वोत्तम, श्रेष्‍ठ; अनुकूलतम)", is a superlative adjective and does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence. • Option 2, **"many(लोगों या वस्‍तुओं की बड़ी संख्‍या, बहुत सारे, अनेक)"**, is a quantifier and does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence. • Option 3, **"the"**, is an article that is used to specify a noun and does not make sense in the sentence. 94:Tdae, The correct answer is **"projects."**
